P_calibration.quote: Proving that evaluation was not the real purpose would be difficult for the government, though a court could read it narrowly.

P_holdback.quote: Publicly pressing a loophole may prompt sponsors to tighten it at markup. Counsel should decide which points to present as technical fixes and which to present as fatal defects.
